editor.js is a bundle of open-source libraries, built from /editor with esbuild:

  CodeMirror 6 (@codemirror/state, view, commands, language, autocomplete, search, lang-python)
    Copyright (C) 2018-2021 by Marijn Haverbeke and others. MIT License.
  Lezer (@lezer/highlight, @lezer/python and friends)
    Copyright (C) 2018 by Marijn Haverbeke and others. MIT License.

The completion names and descriptions come from the installed manimgx package (MIT, Academa Team).
